staff.connection_unavailable: Can’t reach Norma’s local service. Another copy of this build may be running; close it, then reload.
staff.choose_project: Open a project to start a task.
staff.start_hint: Describe your goal. Norma proposes the work and starts after you adopt it.
staff.message_placeholder: Describe a task, add context, or review the result…
staff.image_invalid: This image can’t be read or is over the size limit. Choose another one.
staff.image_too_many: You can add up to 4 images per message.
staff.image_storage_full: Image storage is full. Remove images you no longer need.
staff.image_unavailable: The image couldn’t be saved. Try again.
staff.manual_phase: Phase set by you · Norma will keep it
staff.reopened: Your new message reopened this task.
staff.locate_worker: Show this worker on the canvas
staff.invalid_source: The task source expired. Reopen the project.
staff.agent_unavailable: This agent is missing or disabled.
staff.denied.remove_worker: Staff cannot remove workers; the user does that from the task.
staff.worker_card_gone: This worker's card was closed, so it cannot continue. Start a new worker instead.
staff.proposal_unavailable: This proposal is no longer available.
staff.approval_required: Adopt this proposal in the task first.
staff.worker_needs_attention: The task has not reached this card. Check the card, or send it again to the same card.
staff.worker_failed: Worker could not start or receive the task. Check its card before retrying.
staff.operation_failed: The task operation failed. Please retry. Details were saved to the app log.
staff.footer_hint: Tasks progress independently · Conversations stay with each task
staff.composer_hint: Shift + Enter for a new line
staff.reopen_hint: A new message reopens this task
staff.no_workers: No workers yet. Norma will propose the work.
staff.no_projects: This workspace has no projects yet. Add one to start a task.
staff.response_failed: Response interrupted. Send another message to retry.
staff.question: A question for you
staff.proposal_superseded: A newer proposal is available. This one cannot be restored.
staff.question_unavailable: This question is no longer available.
staff.question_identity_changed: This question has changed. Please reload.
staff.unarchived_toast: Moved back to the task list
staff.archived_note: Archived · hidden from the task list. A new message unarchives it.
staff.archive_empty_hint: Finished tasks can be put here
staff.denied.decide: Staff cannot decide approvals. Tell the user to handle this approval.
staff.denied.answer: Staff cannot answer a question directly. Use propose-answer and wait for the user.
staff.denied.legacy_assign: Staff cannot use the plain assign command. Use task assign or task propose for this task.
staff.denied.reply: Staff no longer uses task reply. Write the reply as plain text in this turn; the host saves it to the conversation.
staff.denied.task_scope: Staff only works on the task of the current turn. Do not create or list tasks.
staff.denied.user_message: Staff cannot post messages as the user.
staff.denied.adopt: Only the user can adopt a proposal.
staff.denied.unarchive: Only the user can restore an archived task.
staff.denied.archive_not_done: Archive a task only after it is done.
staff.denied.other_task: This command targets a different task than the current turn. Work on the current task only.
staff.denied.history_scope: Staff can only read conversations of agents dispatched in this task.
staff.denied.report_rate: Too many proactive reports for this task. Put the content in your task reply instead.
staff.downgrade.autonomy_ask: Staff wanted to dispatch this itself, but follow-ups are set to ask first.
staff.downgrade.not_follow_up: Staff wanted to dispatch this itself, but it is not a follow-up for the same Agent.
staff.downgrade.limit_reached: Staff already auto-dispatched 3 times; it needs your decision.
staff.downgrade.risk: This may be high-risk (push, delete, credentials or spending), so it needs your decision.
staff.worker_cancelled: You withdrew this task and closed the worker card.
staff.worker_remove_body: It is still running. Its card on the canvas will close and this run's progress is lost. Results already in the conversation are kept.
staff.worker_remove_note: The card on the canvas stays
staff.worker_stop_note: The card on the canvas will close
